core: Selective lysosomal degradation of misfolded cytosolic proteins
qualifier: aggresome/aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and late endosomal microautophagy routes
name: Aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and microautophagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: All members concern routing misfolded or aggregated cytosolic proteins to lysosomal degradation (aggresome assembly, aggrephagy, CMA, endosomal microautophagy, ataxin-3 DUBs), unlike confusables centred on organelle-selective autophagy, autophagosome mechanics or ERAD.

qualifier: branchiomotor cranial nerves and brainstem reflexes
name: Hindbrain development, branchiomotor cranial nerves and brainstem reflexes
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/pons/brainstem maturation, hindbrain neuron migration, trigeminal and facial branchiomotor nerves and brainstem-controlled suckling and breathing, distinguishing it from cranial ganglia, cerebellar, spinal cord and locomotor-behaviour neighbours.

qualifier: adrenergic receptor control and catecholamine secretion
name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signalling with adrenergic receptor control
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis, breakdown and PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 effectors, with a strong alpha-2 adrenergic and epinephrine/norepinephrine arm that separates it from cholinergic, purinergic, lysophospholipid and smooth-muscle neighbours.

qualifier: p14ARF defects and p53 loss in cancer
name: p14ARF-p53-p21 tumour-suppressor axis and its cancer defects
rationale: Members concern TP53 regulation driving p21 and G1 arrest and its cancer failure through p14ARF defects or loss of TP53 tetramerization, unlike neighbours built on p16INK4A defects, p53 phosphorylation/degradation or p53-driven apoptosis.

qualifier: leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, catabolism and receptor signalling
name: Leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, catabolism and receptor signalling
rationale: Members cover 5-lipoxygenase products (leukotrienes, lipoxins, 5-HETE), their omega-oxidation and transport, plus leukotriene receptors and signalling, which the 12/15-lipoxygenase, resolvin and P450 neighbours lack.

qualifier: epoxygenase EETs and omega-hydroxylase 20-HETE
name: Cytochrome P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase eicosanoid synthesis
rationale: All members describe P450 epoxygenase (EET/DHET, epoxides) and omega-hydroxylase (16-20-HETE, lipid hydroxylation) branches of arachidonate metabolism, distinct from generic P450 substrate, leukotriene and cyclooxygenase neighbours.

qualifier: type II/IV hypersensitivity and ADCC
name: Type II/IV hypersensitivity, ADCC and antigen-induced acute inflammation
rationale: Most members concern cytotoxic and delayed-type hypersensitivity, ADCC and acute inflammation to antigen (with endopeptidase regulation alongside), distinguishing it from neutrophil degranulation, Fc-receptor/type I and complement neighbours.

qualifier: 3'-end processing, histone mRNA, snRNP assembly and nuclear export
name: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing, snRNP assembly and nuclear mRNA export
rationale: Members cover polyadenylation and histone stem-loop 3'-end processing, Pol II termination, snRNP assembly and export of mature mRNAs through the nuclear pore, unlike neighbours centred on snRNA transcription, splice-site recognition or mRNA decay.

qualifier: to and within the Golgi
name: Vesicle tethering and targeting at the Golgi
rationale: All members are (now obsolete) terms for tethering/targeting vesicles to the Golgi including from rough ER, whereas confusables concern COPI/COPII coat budding and cargo loading.

qualifier: pesticides, dioxin and endocrine disruptors via aryl hydrocarbon receptor
name: Responses to pesticides, dioxin and endocrine-disrupting organic chemicals
rationale: Members are responses to fungicides, herbicides, insecticides, TCDD, bisphenol A and genistein plus AhR signalling, distinct from neighbours on xenobiotic enzymatic metabolism, vitamins or heavy-metal ions.

core: Sulfate-donor and nucleotide-sugar supply for glycosylation
qualifier: PAPS, UDP-glucuronate and nucleotide-sugar transport, with hyaluronan degradation
name: PAPS and UDP-sugar donor supply with hyaluronan degradation
rationale: Most members concern making and transporting PAPS and UDP-sugars (PAPSS2, SLC26A2, SLC35D1, UDP-glucuronate, PAP metabolism, sulfatase activation), plus hyaluronan breakdown, unlike neighbours on Golgi sugar-transporter CDGs, lysosomal storage and GAG chain synthesis.

qualifier: p14ARF/p16INK4A senescence-evasion defects and p53-driven apoptosis
name: p14ARF/p16INK4A-p53 arrest, apoptosis and senescence-evasion defects
rationale: Members combine p53-p21 G1 arrest and p53-driven intrinsic apoptosis with cancer defects in p14ARF and p16INK4A that evade senescence, distinguishing it from RB/E2F, senescence-execution and p53 apoptotic target-gene neighbours.

qualifier: RUNX1 regulation and myeloid, megakaryocytic and lymphoid targets
name: RUNX1 control and its myeloid, megakaryocytic and lymphoid target genes
rationale: All members describe RUNX1 regulation, cofactors and its haematopoietic target programmes (myeloid, megakaryocyte/platelet, BCR, interleukin), separating it from neighbours on granulopoiesis, erythro-megakaryopoiesis and non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

qualifier: MYC-driven RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and rDNA chromatin control
name: MYC-driven polymerase I rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members span Pol I initiation-to-termination, rDNA chromatin regulation (NoRC, SIRT1, B-WICH), rRNA processing and MYC targets, whereas confusables concern Pol III tRNA transcription, translation initiation or small-subunit export.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase cAMP and phospholipase C IP3/calcium
name: GPCR second-messenger generation via adenylate cyclase and phospholipase C
rationale: All members concern GPCR coupling to cAMP synthesis and to PLC/IP3/calcium production, distinct from neighbours on adrenergic inhibition, downstream PKA/PDE effectors or Wnt/lysophospholipid calcium signalling.

qualifier: caspase-cleaved PAK-2p34 death signalling
name: Phosphoinositide-AKT/PTEN and PAK-2p34 serine kinase signalling
rationale: Members cover nuclear PIP synthesis, PTEN/AKT1 and TORC2 signalling and peptidyl-serine phosphorylation, plus PAK-2p34 death signalling that the inositol-phosphate and ERBB/PTEN neighbours lack.

qualifier: cartilage homeostasis and chondrodysplasias
name: Keratan sulfate metabolism and articular cartilage homeostasis
rationale: Members are keratan sulfate synthesis, degradation and its enzyme defects plus cartilage-maintenance processes and chondrodysplasias, unlike neighbours on heparan/chondroitin sulfate or dystroglycan O-mannosylation.

qualifier: osteoblast-osteoclast balance, mineralization and Wnt/TGF-beta signals
name: Osteoblast-osteoclast bone remodelling and mineralization under Wnt/TGF-beta
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation, bone resorption and mineralization with Wnt, TGF-beta/SMAD and stromal/BMP programmes, whereas neighbours focus on ossification, cartilage and tendon development.

qualifier: nutrient-level sensing via leptin and ghrelin
name: Appetite, eating behaviour and responses to nutrient levels
rationale: Members concern regulation of appetite, eating and food response by nutrient status (leptin, ghrelin, sucrose, dietary excess), unlike neighbours on peptide-hormone GPCRs, sleep/wake or growth.

qualifier: intestinal and renal GLUT/SGLT carriers and their disorders
name: Intestinal and renal hexose transport by GLUT and SGLT carriers
rationale: All members describe glucose/galactose/fructose transport and absorption and SLC2A2/SLC5A1/SLC5A2 defects, distinct from urate, amino acid, carbohydrate-digestion and galactose-catabolism neighbours.

core: Protein quality control by ubiquitin-proteasome degradation
qualifier: misfolded proteins, ERAD and degron pathways
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome quality control of misfolded proteins, including ERAD
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein responses, ERAD, N-/C-degron and ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal catabolism and DUBs, unlike neighbours on atypical ubiquitin chains, ribosome QC/stress granules or aggrephagy.

qualifier: hair follicle cycle, nail, sebaceous gland and melanocytes
name: Hair follicle, nail, sebaceous gland and melanocyte development
rationale: Members concern epidermal morphogenesis and appendages (hair follicle anagen and maturation, nail, sebaceous gland) and melanocyte expansion, unlike keratinocyte-differentiation, cornification and placode neighbours.

qualifier: trans-synaptic adhesion organizers (neurexin-neuroligin, RPTPs, SALMs)
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion molecules driving excitatory synapse membrane assembly
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion families and the pre/postsynaptic membrane assembly and NMDA/PSD-95 clustering they drive, distinct from neighbours on inhibitory synapse clustering and synaptic potential regulation.

qualifier: postsynaptic actin-driven dendritic spine and arbor remodelling
name: Postsynaptic actin-driven dendritic spine and arbor remodelling in plasticity
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin, spine morphogenesis, dendrite arborization and long-term plasticity including NMDAR-RAC1, unlike neighbours on EPHB/RHO, BDNF/TRKB or reelin signalling.

qualifier: clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells
name: Microglial activation and clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells
rationale: Members cover microglial activation, proliferation, migration and cytotoxicity with amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance, distinguishing it from efferocytosis-recognition, amyloid fibril and DAP12 neighbours.
